findings.title: Retain disputed assertions and belief revisions separately from knowledge stage

evidence.claim: One record per actor/key; equal-or-higher stage replaces its value, cause, time and basis. Stage order is not an evidence-conflict policy.
Attribution supports recollection/observation/instruction/inference and a named situation/person, without a report chain or evidence history.
Tamsin has recollection and inference, then replaces promise.belief after inspecting the slip.
A funded register check and later spoken correction already provide a useful bounded positive case.

findings.currentPlayerBehavior: The visitor case correctly separates present help from an unmade promise and discloses the correction later. Current topic records alone cannot preserve competing reports or the superseded belief; authored phases/private truth carry this case.
findings.proposedPlayerBehavior: Compare two attributed accounts, demonstrate contrary evidence, keep a confidence or disclose a correction. NPC decisions use their current interpreted belief while the player sees only evidence actually received. Keep observation of an utterance distinct from accepting its proposition as true.

authoritativeOwner.state: Engine knowledge/evidence owner, extending current simulation.knowledge and causal situations
authoritativeOwner.policy: Dialogue GM plus local campaign/source owner

dependencies: Actual observer/channel and occurrence-versus-reveal context from timeline owner
SOC02 commitments must refer to accepted facts, not asserted debts

worldExamples.case: Tamsin receives a second contradictory mill slip; her earlier identification and correction remain attributed, while the player learns only her chosen report.

acceptanceCase.positive: Two conflicting accounts of one promise remain distinguishable; a current believed account can change after new evidence without awarding a taught skill.
acceptanceCase.counterexample: An understood but false identification does not block later correction merely because correction is a lower stage. Hearing Rowan named does not reveal his hidden stock or location.
acceptanceCase.return: A later greeting follows the speaker's current belief; an uninformed third party retains its earlier account until told.
acceptanceCase.laterPublicationGate: Failed disclosure saves no heard record or belief change; replay never transmits news.

findings.cheaperCorrectAlternative: For the first finite dispute, keep separate cause-keyed assertion/evidence records and authored corroboration/correction branches. A probabilistic belief network, global truth score and simulated town-wide rumor mesh are unnecessary.

findings.title: Give accepted promises, debts and favors explicit scope and closure

evidence.claim: Interaction proposals distinguish real loans, gifts, debt settlement and specific memories.
Chronicle ties and bounded display memories support the authored elder obligation without generic agreement terms.
Simulation relationships use axes/memory receipts; unique claims use held/settled ownership rather than negotiated social terms.
Current help and refusal explicitly adopt no old promise or future debt.

findings.currentPlayerBehavior: The elder has a concrete archive-duty tie, and Tamsin correctly refuses to impose an old debt. General debt/accepted favor/renegotiation is still scene-specific scalar state, not a declared shared contract.
findings.proposedPlayerBehavior: Offer, accept, clarify, renegotiate, perform, forgive or contest a specific commitment with actual parties, scope, consideration, due-clock and closure. Distinguish an actor's voluntary unilateral promise from someone else's allegation. An apology, returned loan, unpaid wage and forgiven debt close different things.

acceptanceCase.positive: Two parties can acknowledge amended terms; returning the actual template closes only that loan while an unrelated grievance remains.
acceptanceCase.counterexample: Reading an offer, silence, a gift or an accusation creates no accepted obligation. A closed loan cannot pay twice.
acceptanceCase.return: The known pending/contested/fulfilled agreement selects a different next meeting even after display-memory pruning.
acceptanceCase.laterPublicationGate: Money/stock/custody and agreement changes stage together; failed storage publishes none.

findings.cheaperCorrectAlternative: One explicit agreement policy compiled to existing situation phases and real custody/job receipts is enough for qualification. Add a reusable record only where cross-scene obligations demand it; no universal legal or debt simulator.

findings.title: Make motives choose useful actions without collapsing relationships into a favor bar

evidence.claim: A person may respect skill and refuse a loan; scene-used dimensions and independent initiative are already intended.
Working preferences, interruption, quiet time and practical apology have distinct authored effects.
Joss spends his own stock on private work, offers a report and receives gifts without exchanging a faculty or debt.
Controllers select one eligible paid action using authored predicates and priority; no new general planner is necessary.

findings.currentPlayerBehavior: Finite controllers, preferences and moods already create a few independent responses. Broad goals/relationship labels do not yet specify how competing personal motives alter concrete offers, choices or reconciliation.
findings.proposedPlayerBehavior: Earn reliability for one kind of work, disagree respectfully, choose a shared interest, introduce acquaintances or reconcile a particular harm. An NPC can like the player, disagree with an approach and choose a funded alternative. Friendship, rivalry and professional trust can coexist and yield different offers.

authoritativeOwner.state: Existing directed relations, actor facts/conditions and command/controller owners
authoritativeOwner.policy: Local character/context owner defines exercised motives, priorities and known boundaries

worldExamples.case: Joss values a useful shared room but needs his last kit for private research. He can decline a joint trial, offer a later report or accept a paid shift. Supplying a spare kit changes feasible choices, not universal affection.

acceptanceCase.positive: A funded independent alternative continues after a declined invitation; warm speech can coexist with payment due or a refused request.
acceptanceCase.counterexample: Respect for a successful craft does not clear an unrelated confidentiality breach; waiting for a temporary mood to pass does not erase durable harm.
acceptanceCase.return: Observed help, disagreement and repaired harm cause distinct known responses; repeating greetings creates no progress.

findings.cheaperCorrectAlternative: Use a small character policy with named goals/preferences, known evidence and ordered legal actions. Keep only axes a real scene consumes; no universal charisma, happiness, needs stack, GOAP or live LLM dependency.

findings.proposedPlayerBehavior: Ask for an interpreter, show an object, learn a sign, use a supported translation faculty or clarify whether a gift is thanks, hospitality or a job offer. Keep heard wording, interpreted meaning and accepted terms distinct. Norms belong to a setting/era/institution with individual variation, not one species-wide moral score.

evidence.claim: Teachers retain competence; learners refine methods, with actual resources and lineage.

findings.proposedPlayerBehavior: Demonstrate a refinement, accept critique, teach back, seek an introduction or earn sponsored access. The teacher independently evaluates known evidence and can practice a useful new variant using their own means. A patron funds or endorses a named opportunity without granting competence or control of the learner.

worldExamples.case: An archive alleges Ena's ancestor took a flood fund. Pera has a contrary dated receipt; a local guild heard only the allegation. The player can investigate or disclose evidence, changing only recipients' known reactions.

acceptanceCase.positive: A discovered past event can open a useful route/tradition or credible dispute with actual evidence; correction preserves what people formerly believed.
acceptanceCase.counterexample: Ancestry does not mechanically make descendants guilty, trusted or omniscient. A setting's actual collective pressure can still act through known motives and specific institutions, without becoming author-truth guilt.
acceptanceCase.return: Current family/source/ownership history survives display pruning; changing a prior cause invalidates dependent expectations rather than forcing the old future scene.

findings.cheaperCorrectAlternative: Sparse consequential events and known links, with unknown intervals explicit. Larger history generation can use causally valid templates; no requirement to simulate every prior day or fabricate complete biographies.

worldExamples.case: At Ena's retirement gathering, Hale offers family help, Soren asks to leave the trade and Pera demonstrates a better fitting. Ena can recognize the improvement, preserve a private dispute or propose a successor without guaranteeing one response.

A long-lived master meets former students and their descendants: generation, current body/lifespan and teaching lineage need not align. A school can divide over a method or resource claim rather than through automatic betrayal.

acceptanceCase.positive: A small known family/teacher network yields distinct care, work, discovery or method routes and meaningful independent decisions; a shared tradition can develop beyond its founder.
acceptanceCase.counterexample: Attending/repeating a feast awards no unlimited favor, compulsory loyalty or universally known secret. Wealthy/powerful kin and helpful institutions may offer genuine advantages rather than forced equalization or betrayal.
acceptanceCase.return: Present roles, aging where authorized, learned traditions and known memories select fresh responses; a source's legend reintroduction is not silently treated as YAIRPG resurrection or cross-world identity.

findings.cheaperCorrectAlternative: Promote relevant historical relatives/teachers to stable actors before personal interaction; use compact known family/history views and authored occasions, then expand connected generations where a campaign needs them.
